mission: M3JB run10 trust audit — can we know 0.9209 recall@FAR10 / 0.5428 top1 is real without testing live?
audited_at_unix_note: 2026-06-10 local audit; no Brev, no git push, no deploy

reproduction.method: Loaded run10 .pt (monitor-selected best, epoch 214) into SeqTransformer(d_model256,L6,H8), reran train_recognizer.load() on cache-simccw48, reproduced split_student(seed=0,batch=128), ran softmax forward on the test indices, fed to verification.recall_at_far_details.
reproduction.note: Exact reproduction of both headline numbers from weights+cache validates the harness used for checks 4/5/6.

check_1_split_integrity.question: Are train/monitor/test clip_ids disjoint, and is the split signer-disjoint, not just clip-disjoint?
check_1_split_integrity.method: Grouped 330309 rows.json frame-rows into 10335 clips; verified no clip appears in >1 split; derived PopSign signer = '4a.NNNN' from clip_id; cross-checked signer sets across splits.
check_1_split_integrity.recognizer_internal_split_note: split_student re-pools train+validation (5591+2375=7966), carves 12% (955) as monitor and 7011 as train; TEST (2369) is held out untouched. This is why the receipt shows train_clips=7011/monitor_clips=955. Monitor never draws from test.
check_1_split_integrity.finding: Splits are clip-disjoint AND PopSign-signer-disjoint on every pair. No signer appears in both train and test. ASL Citizen is entirely inside train; test and validation are 100% PopSign.

check_2_landmark_source_leakage.question: Did the SimCC landmark student train on the same clips/signers that are in the recognizer's TEST split (landmark-quality optimism)?
check_2_landmark_source_leakage.method: Parsed the SimCC student's own teacher-labels jsonl (6865 clips, with split + signer + source_record_id). Normalized clip_ids (CAN_2 vs 'CAN 2'). Joined student split vs recognizer split per clip and per PopSign signer.

numbers.recognizer_test_unlabeled_landmark_sourc: student INFERENCE on test-signer clips (student never trained on these signers)

student_receipt_self_report.note: All 8 recognizer-test signers fall in the student's TEST split; landmark quality on recognizer-test is the held-out student PCK ~0.676, not the optimistic train PCK ~0.742.

label_leakage_reasoning_confirmed.student_predicts: hand landmark COORDINATES only (simcc_hand_student.py forward returns (simcc_x, simcc_y); loss = SimCC cross-entropy over coordinate bins)
label_leakage_reasoning_confirmed.sign_class_label_leakage_path: none — the landmark stage never sees word/sign class labels
label_leakage_reasoning_confirmed.only_possible_leakage: landmark-QUALITY optimism on seen signers, which is ruled out: 0 recognizer-test clips/signers were in student-train

check_2_landmark_source_leakage.finding: The recognizer-test landmark quality is INDEPENDENT of student training. Zero recognizer-test clips and zero recognizer-test signers appear in the student's training set; the two stages are signer-aligned. No landmark-quality optimism and no sign-class label leakage.

check_3_distillation_teacher_leakage.question: Does the distill trainer compute/use the teacher (recognizer-v1.pt) on the TEST split during eval?
check_3_distillation_teacher_leakage.method: Read train_recognizer_distill.py main + train_student + precompute_teacher_logits + verification_details.

findings.teacher_logits_precomputed_over: active = concatenate(tr, mon, te) — teacher IS run on test clips, BUT only to fill a logit buffer
findings.training_loop_indices: order = tr.copy() only; loss uses tlog[bi] indexed by TRAIN batch bi; test rows of teacher_logits are never selected during optimization
findings.test_eval_path: verification_details(model, ..., te) -> predict_probabilities runs the STUDENT model softmax only; recall_at_far_details takes student probs; teacher never involved in test metric

check_3_distillation_teacher_leakage.finding: Test recall@FAR10 and test top-1 are the student's own argmax/softmax with zero teacher involvement. The teacher touches test clips only to populate an unused logit buffer; those rows never enter the loss or any reported metric.

check_4_metric_definition_sanity.question: Is FAR10 threshold set on negatives, recall on positives, per class, mean over 95 classes; does the per_class array recompute the headline; is it non-trivial?
check_4_metric_definition_sanity.method: Re-read verification.recall_at_far_details; recomputed mean over receipt per_class[].recall_at_far; checked chance and in-sample realized FAR.

numbers.threshold_rule: tau_w = quantile(neg_w, 1 - far) where neg_w = probs[y != w, w] (negative/other-class clips), far=0.10
numbers.recall_rule: recall_w = mean(pos_w >= tau_w) where pos_w = probs[y == w, w] (true-w clips)

check_4_metric_definition_sanity.finding: Metric is correctly defined: per-class threshold on other-class negatives at the 0.90 quantile, recall on true positives, mean over all 95 classes. The headline 0.9209 is exactly the mean of the per_class array. Top-1 0.5428 is 51.6x chance — not trivially satisfiable.

check_5_calibration_transfer.question: Are run10's accept thresholds fit on a SEPARATE split from where recall is reported? If fit and measured on the same test clips, quantify the honest operating point.
check_5_calibration_transfer.method: Reproduced test+monitor probs. (a) In-sample: thresholds fit on test negatives, recall on test (receipt method). (b) Honest: thresholds fit on MONITOR negatives, applied to test; measured transferred recall and realized FAR.

numbers.honest_realized_far_vs_target: 0.088 < 0.10 (transferred thresholds are slightly CONSERVATIVE — fewer false accepts than target)

check_5_calibration_transfer.finding: The receipt's 0.9209 uses IN-SAMPLE thresholds (fit on the same test negatives where recall is measured) — this is optimistic. The honest operating point (thresholds fit on the held-out monitor split, applied to test) is 0.9087 recall at a realized FAR of 0.088. The optimism is only ~1.2 recall points, and the honest realized FAR is BELOW the 10% target, so the metric is not materially inflated. Deployable accept thresholds must be the monitor/val-fit per-class thresholds, NOT the test-fit ones.

check_6_guardrail_negative_behavior.question: Does run10 reject non-target / wrong-word clips at the FAR10 thresholds? Is the wrong-prompt accept rate bounded ~<=10%?
check_6_guardrail_negative_behavior.method: audit_guardrail_negative_fixtures.mjs in asl-pilot-web targets the RAWFRAME model (train_rawframe_model.py, signed-consent fixtures) and aborts on a missing rawframe vocabulary-review fixture; it does NOT evaluate run10. Substituted a direct cross-negative test: for every (test clip, wrong word) pair, accept iff student prob for the wrong word >= that word's FAR10 threshold.
check_6_guardrail_negative_behavior.finding: When prompted the wrong word, run10 falsely accepts at most 8.8% of the time at deployable (monitor-fit) thresholds, 10.0% at in-sample thresholds. The FAR ceiling is the explicit guardrail and it holds. The rawframe guardrail fixture audit is not applicable to a landmark recognizer.

check_7_promotion_path.question: Is the rawframe promotion gate applicable to run10? Is there any honest claim-matrix/model-card path? What is the AC vs PopSign split and PopSign-only feasibility?

a_what_the_promotion_machinery_is_for.promote_trained_model_card.mjs: Hardwired to the RAWFRAME lane: asl-pilot-rawframe-v0.onnx, artifacts/rawframe-model/{validation-report,calibrated-provenance}.json, requires signed consent_form (asl-pilot-dataset-consent-v1), first_party_consent_capture data mode, 17 negative-challenge types, and a 3D-CNN architecture-family allowlist.
a_what_the_promotion_machinery_is_for.audit_final_claim_matrix.mjs: Currently PASSES; hard-blocks any non-rawframe claim — 'active_cv_claim must be null until a trained rawframe model card is promoted; no Stage A / academic-benchmark claim is permitted' and 'Browser raw RGB/webcam lane must remain not_trained'.
a_what_the_promotion_machinery_is_for.prior_product_decision: M3DI/M3DJ explicitly PARKED the recognition track and redirected to a fail-closed NON-recognition learning MVP (browser_recognition_enabled: false, active_labels: []). Forbidden claim scope includes 'live recognition, automatic grading, trained labels, ASL correctness evaluation'.

b_applicability_to_run10.run10_is: a from-scratch landmark-SEQUENCE transformer recognizer trained on PopSign + ASL Citizen RESEARCH video (offline RTMPose->SimCC landmark pipeline), evaluated on PopSign held-out signers
reasons: run10 is not a raw-RGB 3D-CNN; architecture family is not in the rawframe allowlist
training data is PopSign/ASL-Citizen research video, NOT first-party consent-captured webcam data — there is no signed consent_form / first_party_consent_capture evidence and there cannot be
no rawframe ONNX, validation-report.json, or calibrated-provenance.json exists for run10
the claim-matrix audit hard-fails any active CV claim that is not the promoted rawframe model
b_applicability_to_run10.honest_claim_matrix_or_model_card_path_f: NONE in the existing machinery. Recording run10 as an active CV claim would (1) require falsely asserting a rawframe / first-party-consented-data claim, and (2) fail audit_final_claim_matrix.mjs. The only truthful surfaces today are: (i) keep claim-matrix/model-card unchanged (active_cv_claim: null), and (ii) record run10 strictly as a research/ML-evidence validation receipt under docs/validation/ (like this file), NOT as a product CV claim.

c_asl_citizen_redistribution.license: ASL Citizen noncommercial school-assignment license (Microsoft Research)
c_asl_citizen_redistribution.constraint: AC-derived weights should not be distributed publicly without Microsoft permission; PopSign-only avoids this
c_asl_citizen_redistribution.implication: run10's WEIGHTS are AC-derived (57.5% of training volume is AC) -> public distribution of run10 weights carries the AC noncommercial constraint and needs Microsoft permission. The reported metric is computed on a 100%-PopSign test set.

popsign_only_retrain_feasibility.aslcitizen_train_clips_per_class: 0..123 (median 31, total 3216); 5 classes have no AC train
popsign_only_retrain_feasibility.estimate: A PopSign-only retrain keeps all 95 classes and the identical 100%-PopSign test set, but drops 57.5% of training volume (AC mainly adds per-class diversity/volume on top of uniform 25 PopSign clips). Expect a moderate accuracy/recall drop (AC removal cuts >half the training signal) but not class collapse. NOT retrained here — estimate only.

do_not: Do NOT run scripts/promote_trained_model_card.mjs for run10 (it is rawframe-only and would require false consent/first-party evidence).
Do NOT set active_cv_claim or flip the browser lane off not_trained (audit_final_claim_matrix.mjs would block it and it would be a false rawframe claim).
Do NOT publicly distribute run10's AC-derived weights without Microsoft permission.
recommendation.correct_action: No honest PRODUCT promotion exists yet. Record run10 only as a research/ML-evidence validation receipt under docs/validation/ (this file). If a recognition product claim is ever desired, the truthful options are: (a) train the actual rawframe first-party lane the promotion machinery is built for, or (b) define a NEW, separate claim-matrix lane for an offline-landmark-recognizer evaluated on research data (PopSign held-out signers) with explicit boundaries (research data, not first-party webcam; landmark sequence, not raw RGB; in-the-wild webcam performance UNVALIDATED) and a PopSign-only retrain for any distributable weights. Both require human approval and new audit support; neither is the existing rawframe gate.
recommendation.if_shipping_as_demo_only: Ship run10 ONLY behind a clearly-labeled non-production demo surface (e.g. /pilot or /practice prototype) with monitor-fit thresholds, an explicit 'research-data accuracy, webcam performance not validated' disclaimer, and AC-derived-weights kept non-public. Do not record it as a model-card/claim-matrix CV claim.

deploy_trust_verdict.summary: The 0.9209 number is real and reproducible (exact reproduction from weights+cache), the split is clip- and PopSign-signer-disjoint, the landmark student and distill teacher introduce no leakage, and the FAR guardrail holds. It is trustworthy as a RESEARCH-DATA operating-point metric. It is NOT a validated in-the-wild webcam number and must not be promoted through the rawframe product gate.
deploy_trust_verdict.single_most_important_caveat: 0.9209 is the IN-SAMPLE-threshold operating point on a 100%-PopSign, research-quality landmark TEST set drawn from held-out PopSign signers. The honest (held-out-threshold) recall is 0.909 at ~8.8% realized FAR; live webcam landmark quality is NOT what this test measures, and run10's weights are AC-derived (57.5% of training) so they carry the Microsoft noncommercial-redistribution constraint.

promotion_recommendation.next_step_if_recognition_product_wanted: human-approved NEW claim-matrix lane for offline-landmark research-data recognizer with explicit boundaries + PopSign-only retrain for distributable weights, OR train the first-party rawframe lane the existing machinery is built for
files_that_would_need_to_change_for_a_tr: scripts/audit_final_claim_matrix.mjs (add a separate non-rawframe research-recognizer lane with its own boundaries; do NOT relax the rawframe active_cv_claim==null gate)
a NEW promotion script (the existing promote_trained_model_card.mjs is rawframe-only and must not be reused)
